output_artifact_shape: Public projection of actual returned pipeline items: task_id, record_id, status, embedding, error, and model.

observed_facts.extraction_method: UTF-8 decode with Python standard library

negative_path.case: one JSONL row missing required text

unavailable_or_withheld.chunk_text_in_output: Not returned. The manifest preserves public source identity and the character range encoded in each record ID.
unavailable_or_withheld.prepared_input_rows: Not included in the public bundle. The internal evidence archive retains the exact run evidence.
unavailable_or_withheld.model_digest: not returned by the customer-facing API or downloaded pipeline artifact
unavailable_or_withheld.page_count: not applicable because this smallest run used plain-text documents, not PDFs
unavailable_or_withheld.per_item_retry_count: not returned; only run-level retry_count_total was exposed
unavailable_or_withheld.per_item_token_count: not returned; no tokenizer-derived value was added
unavailable_or_withheld.retention_until: returned as null; no retention duration inferred

redactions: internal node hostname and client identifier
node, GPU, provider, power, batching, and per-record timing telemetry
run-date source snapshots containing superseded public contact and positioning copy
caveats: This is a three-document, seven-chunk public sample, not a scale or distributed-performance benchmark.
The input branch was clean UTF-8 text. Raw PDF extraction and PDF page counting were not exercised.
No OCR, layout parsing, structured extraction, vector database, hosted RAG, or search service was included.
The public output is a customer-relevant field projection of actual returned pipeline items; embeddings were not synthesized or altered.
